title: GenDSR: Transferring Representations from Video Generation Models for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41314v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic spatial reasoning is essential for connecting visual intelligence to thephysical world, yet remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs), which must preserve scene state while tracking how spatial relations evolve over time. Meanwhile, video generation models (VGMs), trained to synthesize temporally coherent world dynamics, offer a rich source of spatiotemporal representations. We present GenDSR, a framework that transfers intermediate representations from VGM into VLM for dynamic spatial reasoning. Rather than treating a VGM feature as a monolithic prior, GenDSR constructs two complementary branches: a raw branch preserving holistic generative context and a delta branch emphasizing temporal variation. Task-conditioned tokenwise gates then fuse both signals and inject the result into the native visual representation. translated_title: GenDSR：从视频生成模型迁移表示以实现动态空间推理
translated_abstract: 动态空间推理对于连接视觉智能与物理世界至关重要，但对视觉-语言模型（VLM）而言仍然具有挑战性，因为这些模型必须在跟踪空间关系随时间演化的同时保持场景状态。与此同时，视频生成模型（VGM）经过训练能够合成时间上一致的世界动态，为时空表示提供了丰富的来源。我们提出了GenDSR，这是一个将VGM的中间表示迁移到VLM中以实现动态空间推理的框架。GenDSR并未将VGM特征视为单一的整体先验，而是构建了两个互补的分支：一个保留整体生成上下文的原始分支，以及一个强调时间变化的增量分支。随后，任务条件化的逐token门控机制融合这两种信号，并将结果注入到原生的视觉表示中。在DSR-Bench上，GenDSR达到了67.2%，超越了此前最佳结果，建立了新的最先进水平。
tldr: GenDSR框架通过将视频生成模型的互补时空表示（原始分支与增量分支）迁移到视觉-语言模型中，在动态空间推理基准DSR-Bench上取得67.2%的新最佳成绩。
en_tdlr: GenDSR transfers complementary spatiotemporal representations (raw and delta branches) from video generation models into vision-language models, achieving a new state-of-the-art 67.2% on the dynamic spatial reasoning benchmark DSR-Bench.
